In the Zone, a carcass makes poor cover. You know where to guide the blade: take what you need and leave before the blood brings the next predator.
 
%c[ui_gray_3]EFFECTS:
%c[ui_gray_2]Mutant skinning animation speed x2: the cut takes half as long relative to the current FDDA Redone speed. Knife wear from skinning is reduced by 50% of the actual condition loss in the original system. One rank.
 
%c[d_red]REQUIRES the FDDA Redone mutant skinning module (liz_fdda_redone_mutant_skinning / lam2). Without it, the perk has no effect. This integration does not support classic FDDA.
